note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording, the wording borrowed from other Amharic works, and the translator-rendered verses the first edition carried — including the daily heading verses, which the first edition's notes mostly recorded as self_rendered.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; verbatim recitations without quote marks count. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions and the authors' own paraphrases left as prose, quotations recast to another person, and places where OWB cannot serve: critical-text omissions (Acts 20:24, Rev 22:14), and readings whose point hangs on a KJV/RV word OWB does not use (e.g. 1 Kings 17:3 'brook', 2 Sam 22:36 'gentleness', 2 Cor 13:11 'be perfect', 1 Chr 4:23 'plants and hedges', Gen 32:32 'touched').
